Kitchen chimney service & repair in Chennai

A well fitted, well maintained kitchen chimney keeps smoke, oil and cooking smells out of your home. We install new chimneys, clean and maintain existing ones, sort out suction problems and handle repairs for wall mounted, island and cylinder chimneys.

What we help with

Installation

Chimney installation

We fit new wall mounted and island chimneys at the right height above the hob, with a sensible duct route and a suitable power point.

Maintenance

Cleaning and maintenance

We clean the filters, blower and hood to clear the grease that slowly reduces suction over time.

Repair

Suction and performance checks

We find out why smoke is not clearing, whether it is blocked filters, a duct problem, a weak motor or the way it was installed.

Repair

Chimney repairs

Motors, switches, touch panels, lights and auto clean faults. Tell us the brand and model and we will talk you through the repair.

Common kitchen chimney problems and needs

  1. Smoke or cooking smells not clearing
  2. Motor louder than usual or vibrating
  3. Oil dripping from the hood or filters
  4. Touch panel, buttons or lights not responding
  5. A new chimney to install
  6. Island or cylinder chimney due for cleaning

Safety first. Switch the chimney off at the wall before wiping the outside. Leave dismantling, motor and wiring work to a technician.

Kitchen Chimneys: frequently asked questions

How often should a kitchen chimney be cleaned?

It depends on how much you cook and fry. Homes that cook every day often need a professional clean every few months. Your manufacturer's manual is the best guide.

Do you install chimneys bought online?

Yes. Send us the brand and model with a short description of your kitchen, and we will plan the installation with you.

Do you work on island and cylinder chimneys?

Yes. Ceiling mounted island and cylinder chimneys need different access and mounting from wall models, and we work on both.

My auto clean chimney still smells of oil. Why?

Auto clean heats the oil collector so the grease can drain, but it does not clean the blower or the duct. Those parts still need a manual clean.

Which chimney brands do you service?

We are an authorised Elica service company and also service Butterfly chimneys. For any other brand, send us the brand and model and we will let you know.
